title: agropyron fragile subsp. sibiricum
intro: Agropyron fragile subsp. sibiricum, commonly known as Siberian wheatgrass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is a perennial plant native to Siberia and has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Siberian wheatgrass include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to treat various health conditions such as arthritis, digestive issues, and skin problems. The bioactive constituents of Siberian wheatgrass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
